facts.value: Discover how health care professionals contribute experiences, skill sets and resources that lead to positive outcomes for patients in this online Bachelor of Science in medical studies from Arizona State University. Upon completing this pre-med bachelor’s degree program, you’ll be prepared with the scientific background and interpersonal skills needed to pursue graduate studies in health care.
